meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

copy.tagline: 把散落在 .env 里的密钥搬进统一保险库,并完成命令行工具的首次初始化配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你刚装好命令行工具,想把项目里的密钥从 .env 收进保险库
copy.tagline_en: Migrate scattered .env credentials into a managed vault and finish first-time setup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed a CLI tool and want its .env secrets moved into a vault

howto.what: Claude 会安装 OneCLI、配置 Agent Vault 网关,并把 .env 里的 Anthropic 等凭证迁移进 vault,迁移后从 .env 中删除原始密钥行。
howto.when: 在你运行 /update-nanoclaw 引入 OneCLI 破坏性变更后,或首次从零设置 OneCLI 时接管;也可选择重新配置。

say.note: 安装并配置 Agent Vault 网关

say.text: 把 .env 里的 Anthropic 凭证迁移到 OneCLI vault
say.note: 迁移后从 .env 删除密钥行

say.text: 帮我把 OPENAI_API_KEY 也移到 vault
say.note: 以 api_key 类型注册到 api.openai.com

howto.what_en: Claude installs OneCLI, configures the Agent Vault gateway, and migrates existing .env credentials such as Anthropic into the vault, removing the raw key lines from .env.
howto.when_en: Takes over after /update-nanoclaw introduces OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup from scratch.

say_en.note: Installs and configures the Agent Vault gateway

say_en.text: Migrate my Anthropic credentials from .env into the OneCLI vault
say_en.note: Removes the raw key lines from .env after migrating

say_en.text: Move OPENAI_API_KEY into the vault too
say_en.note: Registers it as an api_key for api.openai.com
